end.parentNote: Ananya practised identifying changes by checking whether a new substance formed, using reversibility only as a clue. They correctly classified paper tearing, melting ice, melting ghee, curd formation, and milk changing into curd, and later stated that a physical change does not make a new substance. At home, ask Ananya to explain two examples using the sentence: “No new substance forms, so it is a physical change.”
